thread:
Maria: Hey sec + eng — we need to lock a 60m slot next week for a combined threat-model + audit-prep session for payments-v3. Core ask: validate threat surface, review access controls, and confirm audit artifacts.

Maria: Proposed agenda (can trim):
- 5m quick context (product goals)
- 15m threat model walkthrough (assumptions, data flows)
- 15m access matrix & IAM review
- 10m audit artifacts checklist (logs, retention, evidence)
- 10m RFC #452 quick feedback (auth flow changes)
- 5m action items + owners

Maria: Pre-reads: https://redwood.internal/docs/payments-v3/threat-model-draft (please skim) + RFC #452 link.

Maria: Candidate times (PT): Tue 9:00-10:00, Wed 13:00-14:00, Thu 16:00-17:00. Reply with which works or +1 for multiple. If we hit consensus I'll send an invite and attach pre-reads.

Alex: Tue 9 works for me.

Dan: Wed is cleaner for me — deploy on Tue morning. If we must do Tue I can carve out 30m but not ideal.

Priya: I can do Tue or Thu. I'll prepare the access matrix and sample retention proof.

Alex: also - can we squeeze in a 10m slot to cover outstanding code-review/blockers on payments-v3 branch? There's one auth change in RFC #452 that might affect threat assumptions.

Maria: good call, adding RFC item.

SecBot: Reminder: for audit evidence we need hashed logs for 90d retention + export path documented. Add a "data-classification" section to pre-reads.

Dan: noted. Priya — can you include an example export script or the retention config?

Priya: yes, will attach sample logs + config snippet by EOD.

Alex: pinging @legal and @product leads — can someone confirm they can attend Tue 9 if we lock it? We need signoff on compliance controls.

Maria: I'll ping product and legal offline.

Priya: quick QA note — if we change auth flow per RFC 452 we should list fallback behavior for older clients. I'll draft a short compatibility matrix.

Maria: leaning toward Tue 9 since most folks can. Locking the time unless objections by EOD. If you can't make it, please add cover and mention which section you own. :thumbsup:

SecBot: Calendar placeholder created (will update with final invite).

Alex: :thumbsup:  (I'll add the CR link in the thread).

Dan: I'll try to move deploy tasks — prefer Tue but can join Wed partial if needed.

Priya: sending pre-reads in ~4h.

Maria: thanks everyone — agenda updated, will send invite with attachments once I hear back from legal.

Alex: also quick heads-up — there's a small TODO in RFC CI that I want reviewed before the meeting. Will drop it in #eng-releases.

Maria: noted. See you Tue 9am PT (tentative).
